data.exact_reserve_text: In 2018, there has been an overall net surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 3.2m (2017: GBP 2.9m) due to lower than expected incurred movements across most classes of business.

prior_year_events.impact_description: accepted additional liabilities by way of reinsurance to close from Syndicate 6103 for the underwriting years 2007 to 2015 inclusive.

material exposure to Irish Motor bodily injury claims in the 2016 and prior years of account. However, this exposure does not lead to a material increase in the uncertainty of the syndicate's total reserves in an adverse direction.

named_events.loss_description: Ultimate net losses to the 2017 year of account... are projected to be $50.2m, representing nearly 40 percentage points of net loss ratio, albeit less than 10% on Stamp due to the historically low utilisation.
plethora of catastrophes that occurred in 2017, notably Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, as well as the California Wildfires.

catastrophe incidence was similarly elevated to 2017, with hurricanes Florence and Michael impacting the US, four significant loss events in Asia, followed by a repeat of the Californian Wildfires. Across all years of account we are projecting ultimate gross catastrophe losses of $56.5m, with a year-end incurred of $32.2m. Ultimate net losses are projected to be $50.3m, which represents over 22 percentage points on net earned premium

data.standardized_narrative: In 2018, Syndicate 2791 experienced an overall net surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 3.2m, indicating a release of prior year reserves. This favorable development was attributed to lower than expected incurred movements across most classes of business. The claims development triangle is distorted by Reinsurance to Close (RITC) from Syndicate 6103 for underwriting years 2007 to 2015, making it unreliable for calculating gross prior year development. The syndicate also noted material exposure to Irish Motor bodily injury claims in 2016 and prior years, but this did not lead to an adverse impact on reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: lower than expected incurred movements across most classes of business

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported net of reinsurance as no gross figure was explicitly available due to RITC distortions in the claims development triangle. The claims development triangle on page 34 is distorted by the acceptance of Reinsurance to Close (RITC) from Syndicate 6103 for underwriting years 2007 to 2015, making it unreliable for calculating gross prior year development.
